<translate>
'''The Cell Games''' is a four-star '''bracket''' tournament hosted by [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] at the Cell Arena on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. You fight through a bracket of Z Fighters from the Cell Saga, then Teen Gohan in the semi-final and '''Super Perfect Cell''' in the final. It is the only '''lethal''' tournament: a lost bout is a real death.
</translate>

{{Note|type=danger|title=<translate>Lethal ring</translate>|<translate>In the Cell Games, losing a bout kills you. Every other tournament ends its bouts at knockout.</translate>}}

<translate>
== Getting there ==

The [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Arena|Cell Arena]] generates in the plains of the Overworld. A [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]] of tier 3 sells a map to it for 1 Tier-1 Radar Chip. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]].

Cell only talks to players with '''Evil alignment''' (40 or less), as he does as a master (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|Alignment]]). Talk to him, press '''Tournament''' and then '''Enter''' while you are within 12 blocks of him. The arena can't be built in or broken by survival players (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments#Arena protection|arena protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Format ==

This tournament is a '''bracket''' of 8 seats filled with random contenders. Winners climb the ladder, and fights between two NPCs are decided automatically. After the qualifier rounds, the survivor faces the semi-finalist, then the champion. Only those two are known before you enter; the rest of the draw is revealed once everybody accepts the rules.

With a party, each member has their own seat; if the draw puts two members against each other, they fight a PvP bout. Each bout lasts up to '''7 minutes'''; a bout that runs out of time is void and fought again. The general rules for entering and bouts are on [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Fighters ==

The contenders are drawn from the Z Fighters of the Cell Saga: Goku, Teen Gohan, Vegeta and Future Trunks (in their base and Super Saiyan forms), Piccolo, Krillin, Tien Shinhan, Yamcha and Android 16. By default they have between 66,500 and 210,000 health, 2,700 to 8,700 melee damage and 2,420 to 7,820 ki damage, fight on the Novice to Elite AI tiers, and get 8% stronger for every round already played.
</translate>

<translate>
== Rewards ==

Beating Super Perfect Cell wins '''1,000,000 TP''' and '''+10 alignment''', with fireworks and the victory music. Losing a bout, withdrawing or being disqualified puts you on a '''60-minute''' cooldown before you can enter again; winning starts the same cooldown.
</translate>
